what: On first open, a thin bar (200px · 3px, 160px on phone) under the logo at the center of the background-color veil fills in 1.2s power2.inOut, rests .2s, then the logo and bar lift 20px and vanish in .4s. From .2s before that ends, a round hole opens from the bottom center of the veil to the screen edge in 1.5s power2.inOut (30% feathered edge), so the page is revealed from bottom to top in a round shape. Scroll unlocks and fx:open fires as the hole begins to open, and fx:done when fully open

options.[data-fx-part=inner]: Logo and bar cluster (exits upward, optional)
options.rest: Rest duration after fully filled (s), default .2
options.hole: Length of time the hole opens (sec), default 1.5
options.lock: If off, scrolling is not blocked while it spins (default is blocked)
options.safety: Clears the curtain after this many seconds, default 8

use: — Hero entrance via document.addEventListener("fx:open", …)
note: On app screens that are flipped often, use smaller dur and hole values

from.where: index.html .dd-loading (logo 120px · bar 200×3, phone 80px · 160px — when the hole starts to open, the hero title · copy · photo · round button go y 40→0 in 1.2s power3.out with .15 stagger, 8s safety clear)
